instruction: Design a system that combines two shift registers with parallel load and active high asynchronous reset. Each shift register is an 8-bit shift register that can shift data to the left or right direction based on the control input. The shift registers should be triggered by the negative edge of clk. The system should include an additional control logic module that enables either the first shift register or the second shift register based on a select input. The output should be the active shift register's value. The initial value of each shift register should be 0x34.
